verdict.rationale: Qodo docs describe connecting to your Git provider so it automatically reviews every pull request directly in the PR (qodo-docs-42, qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-26), with GitHub and GitLab named as supported (qodo-docs-8). Findings can be discussed, dismissed or auto-fixed inside the PR (qodo-docs-3, qodo-docs-23), a setup wizard guides onboarding (qodo-docs-18), and a community user confirms running Qodo's review bot on PRs for two years (qodo-comm-1). missing for 10: explicit evidence that findings are posted as native inline line-level comments, evidence of the 'within minutes' setup or review turnaround, and explicit documentation of installation as a GitHub/GitLab app.
